title: Risk of Hepatitis Flare in Patients With Previous Hepatitis B Virus Exposure Amongst Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study the risk of hepatitis flare in patients with previous hepatitis B virus exposure amongst patients on immunosuppressive and biological modifier therapies
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years old at the time of starting biological modifier therapies or at the time of recruitment
* Positive for anti-HBc OR
* Positive for anti-HBs and born before year 1988

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known HBV carrier with HBsAg positive
* Concomitant HCV and/ or HIV infection
* Already on HBV anti-viral
* Refuse to consent
* Baseline ALT \> 80 IU/ml
study_population: All patients with previous HBV exposure who are already on biological modifier therapies and who will be newly started on biological modifier therapies in the Department of Medicine and Therapeutics, Prince of Wales Hospital and Department of Medicine, University Malaya Medical Centre will be recruited.
